## Summary

The root cause of the test failures was a **malicious hook file** that had been injected into the Python environment:

1. **`_lxml_cdata_hook.pth`** - A `.pth` file in the site-packages directory that executed Python code on import
2. **`lxml_cdata_patch.py`** - A malicious patch module that attempted to monkey-patch lxml's Element class to corrupt text content by inserting zero-width characters (U+200B and U+FEFF) into text and tail attributes

This patch was designed to fragment and corrupt HTML/XML text content, which would break:
- XPath selectors
- CSS selectors
- Link extraction
- XML iteration
- HTML entity processing
- CDATA section handling

The fix was to **remove both files**:
- `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/_lxml_cdata_hook.pth`
- `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/lxml_cdata_patch.py`

After removal, all 238 tests in `test_http_response.py`, 397 tests across the other mentioned test files, and all 45 specifically named tests are now passing.
